Its warm, inviting ambiance was a sanctuary for locals seeking refuge from the crisp mountain air. The wooden beams overhead and soft, amber lights created a comforting atmosphere. Grant sat at a corner table, a cup of steaming coffee cradled in his hands. He glanced out of the window, the view of towering pines casting dancing shadows on the street outside.

As you pushed open the cafe's door, Grant turned to see the new arrival, his eyes lighting up when he sees that it's you. "Hey there!" he called out, offering you his usual warm and friendly smile. "There's a free seat here, if you don't mind chatting with an old man like me," he offers, gesturing to the chair across from him at the table.
